label: Respondent ID
coding: GSS respondent identifier
note: Unique within the 2024 cross-section.

label: Rating of Donald Trump
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Conservative
coding: 1 = slightly conservative / conservative / extremely conservative; 0 = extremely liberal / liberal / slightly liberal / moderate, middle of the road
gss_label: Think of self as liberal or conservative
note: From the seven-point liberal-conservative scale; moderates are grouped with liberals.

label: Female
coding: 1 = female; 0 = male

label: Age
coding: Numeric, 18 to 89
note: 89 = 89 or older.

label: White
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
note: A race mention: respondents could name more than one race, so a respondent can be 1 here and in another race column.

label: Black
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
note: A race mention: respondents could name more than one race, so a respondent can be 1 here and in another race column.

label: Hispanic
coding: 1 = mexican, mexican american, chicano/a / puerto rican / cuban / another hispanic, latino, or spanish origin; 0 = not hispanic
note: 1 = any Hispanic, Latino or Spanish origin.

label: Born in the US
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
gss_label: Was R born in this country

label: Speaks another language
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
gss_label: Can R speak language other than English/Spanish
note: Another language than the one of the interview (English or Spanish).

label: Lesbian, gay or bisexual
coding: 1 = gay, lesbian, or homosexual / bisexual; 0 = heterosexual or straight

label: Married
coding: 1 = married; 0 = widowed / divorced / separated / never married
note: 0 = widowed, divorced, separated or never married.

label: Adults in household
coding: Numeric, 1 to 6
gss_label: Household members 18 yrs and older (Household Roster)
note: From the household roster; 8 = 8 or more.

label: Number of children
coding: Numeric, 0 to 8
note: Children ever born alive; 8 = 8 or more.

label: Number of siblings
coding: Numeric, 0 to 6
gss_label: Number of siblings (including step- and adopted)
note: Including step- and adopted siblings; 6 = 6 or more.

label: Time on active military duty
coding: 0 = No active duty, 1 = Yes, less than 2 years, 2 = Yes, 2-4 years, 3 = Yes, more than 4 years
values: 0=No active duty|1=Yes, less than 2 years|2=Yes, 2-4 years|3=Yes, more than 4 years
note: Respondents who served but did not know for how long are missing.

label: Years of education
coding: Numeric, 0 to 20
note: Highest year of school completed; 20 = 8 or more years of college.

label: Highest degree
coding: 0 = Less than high school, 1 = High school, 2 = Associate/junior college, 3 = Bachelor's, 4 = Graduate
note: Highest degree completed.

label: Mother's education
coding: 0 = Less than high school, 1 = High school, 2 = Associate/junior college, 3 = Bachelor's, 4 = Graduate
gss_label: Mother's (or youngest same-sex parent's) highest degree
note: Highest degree of the mother (or youngest same-sex parent).

label: Father's education
coding: 0 = Less than high school, 1 = High school, 2 = Associate/junior college, 3 = Bachelor's, 4 = Graduate
gss_label: Father's (or oldest same-sex parent's) highest degree
note: Highest degree of the father (or oldest same-sex parent).

label: Family income
coding: 26 ordered categories: 1 = Under $1,000 to 26 = $170,000 or over
note: Total family income last year, in 26 ordered dollar ranges.

label: Relative family income
coding: 1 = Far below average, 2 = Below average, 3 = Average, 4 = Above average, 5 = Far above average
values: 1=Far below average|2=Below average|3=Average|4=Above average|5=Far above average
note: Family income compared with American families in general.

label: Social class
coding: 1 = Lower class, 2 = Working class, 3 = Middle class, 4 = Upper class
note: Subjective social class; the option 'no class' (chosen by nobody in 2024) is missing.

label: Occupational prestige
coding: Numeric, 16 to 80
note: Prestige score of the respondent's occupation (2010 scores).

label: Employed
coding: 1 = working full time / working part time / with a job, but not at work because of temporary illness, vacation, strike; 0 = unemployed, laid off, looking for work / retired / in school / keeping house / other
note: From labour force status: 1 = working full or part time, or with a job but temporarily not at work; 0 = unemployed, retired, in school, keeping house or other.

label: Government employee
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
note: Employed by federal, state or local government in the current or last job.

label: Uses a computer
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no

label: Region
coding: Text: Northeast, Midwest, South, West
note: Region of interview: the four U.S. Census regions.

label: Rural/small-town upbringing
coding: 1 = in open country but not on a farm / farm / in a small city or town (under 50,000); 0 = in a medium-size city (50,000-250,000) / in a suburb near a large city / in a large city (over 250,000)
gss_label: Type of place lived in when 16 yrs old
note: Place lived at 16: 1 = open country, farm, or a town under 50,000.

label: Moved since age 16
coding: 1 = Same state, same city, 2 = Same state, different city, 3 = Different state
values: 1=Same state, same city|2=Same state, different city|3=Different state
note: Where the respondent lived at 16, compared with now.

label: Neighbours of the other race (Black/white)
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
note: Black respondents were asked about white neighbours; all other respondents about Black neighbours.

label: Religious attendance
coding: 0 = Never, 1 = Less than once a year, 2 = About once or twice a year, 3 = Several times a year, 4 = About once a month, 5 = 2-3 times a month, 6 = Nearly every week, 7 = Every week, 8 = Several times a week
values: 0=Never|1=Less than once a year|2=About once or twice a year|3=Several times a year|4=About once a month|5=2-3 times a month|6=Nearly every week|7=Every week|8=Several times a week
gss_label: How often R attends religious services

label: Frequency of prayer
coding: 0 = Never, 1 = Less than once a week, 2 = Once a week, 3 = Several times a week, 4 = Once a day, 5 = Several times a day
values: 0=Never|1=Less than once a week|2=Once a week|3=Several times a week|4=Once a day|5=Several times a day

label: Born again
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
gss_label: Has R ever had a 'born again' experience
note: Has had a 'born again' experience.

label: No religion
coding: 1 = none; 0 = protestant / catholic / jewish / other / buddhism / hinduism / other eastern religions / muslim/islam / orthodox-christian / christian / native american / inter-nondenominational
note: From religious preference: 1 = none; 0 = any religion.

label: Likelihood of voting
coding: 1 = Not at all likely, 2 = Not very likely, 3 = Somewhat likely, 4 = Very likely, 5 = Extremely likely
values: 1=Not at all likely|2=Not very likely|3=Somewhat likely|4=Very likely|5=Extremely likely
note: Likelihood of voting in the 2024 election. Not asked of respondents who were not U.S. citizens (or becoming citizens), so they are missing.

label: Satisfaction with democracy
coding: 1 = Not at all satisfied, 2 = Not very satisfied, 3 = Fairly satisfied, 4 = Very satisfied
values: 1=Not at all satisfied|2=Not very satisfied|3=Fairly satisfied|4=Very satisfied
gss_label: R satisfied with way democracy works in America
note: Satisfaction with the way democracy works in America.

label: Happiness
coding: 1 = Not too happy, 2 = Pretty happy, 3 = Very happy

label: Self-rated health
coding: 1 = Poor, 2 = Fair, 3 = Good, 4 = Excellent

label: Change in finances
coding: 1 = Worse, 2 = Stayed same, 3 = Better
note: Over the last few years.

label: Financial satisfaction
coding: 1 = Not satisfied at all, 2 = More or less satisfied, 3 = Pretty well satisfied
values: 1=Not satisfied at all|2=More or less satisfied|3=Pretty well satisfied

label: Mental health diagnosis
coding: 1 = yes; 0 = no
gss_label: R ever diagnosed with MH problem
note: Ever diagnosed with a mental health problem.

label: Rating of Kamala Harris
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Rating of Joe Biden
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Rating of the Democratic Party
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Rating of the Republican Party
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Rating of MAGA Republicans
coding: Numeric, 0 to 100
note: Feeling thermometer from 0 (least favourable) to 100 (most favourable), from the GSS-ANES module.

label: Rating of the economy
coding: 1 = Very bad, 2 = Bad, 3 = Neither bad nor good, 4 = Good, 5 = Very good
gss_label: WHAT DO YOU THINK ABOUT THE STATE OF THE ECONOMY THESE DAYS IN THE UNITED STATES
note: The state of the economy these days in the United States.

label: Preferred immigration level
coding: 1 = Reduced a lot, 2 = Reduced a little, 3 = Remain the same as it is, 4 = Increased a little, 5 = Increased a lot
values: 1=Reduced a lot|2=Reduced a little|3=Remain the same as it is|4=Increased a little|5=Increased a lot
gss_label: Number of immigrants nowadays should be
note: The number of immigrants to America nowadays should be...

label: College degree
coding: 1 = bachelor's / graduate; 0 = less than high school / high school / associate/junior college
note: From highest degree: 1 = bachelor's or graduate degree. As W, leave degree and educ out of X: they determine it.

label: Survey weight
coding: Post-stratification and nonresponse weight for the full sample; optional
gss_label: POSTSTRATIFICATION AND NONRESPONSE WEIGHT FOR ANALYZING GSS WITH AMERISPEAK OVER
note: NORC's recommended weight (WTSSNRPS), extended to the AmeriSpeak oversample of Black, Hispanic, and Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander respondents; use it to describe U.S. adults.

label: Sampling cluster
coding: Sampling stratum x primary sampling unit; optional
note: Variance stratum and primary sampling unit, for clustered sampling.
